This second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to F I R No. 363/2023 dated 14.08.2023 registered at Police Station Kotwali Anuppur, District Anuppur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 3/4, 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012 and section 67 of Information Technology (Amended) Act, 2008.
Applicant is in detention since 15.08.2023.

sentences.text:

2.
As per the prosecution story, 15 years and 07 months old prosecutrix lodged an F.I.R alleging that she knew Kartik Kol for last two years.
They both exchanged their mobile numbers.
It is alleged that on 08.05.2022 Kartik Kol on false promise of marriage established physical relations with her.
Thereafter, they continuously established physical relations.
4-5 days ago Santosh Rathore had forwarded a message on her Instagram I.D.
After watching that message, Kartik had threatened her to defame.
Her mother had informed her that someone has posted her nude photo on social media.
When she opened her Instagram I.D, she saw her nude photo.
Her Instagram I.D was being used by Kartik Kol.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
H e has been falsely implicated.

No photo was posted by him and no rape/
aggravated penetrative sexual assault was committed by him upon the prosecutrix.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix and her mother have already been examined before the trial court.
They have not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail to the applicant.
5. In this case prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.

Having considered the change in circumstances but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant - Kishan @ Kartik Kol be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE MKL Kishan @ Kartik Kol vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154832145/
